data.description:
testing_mode: GREEN

## Goal
Create `plugins/dso/scripts/lib/ci-findings-normalize.sh` so all 5 T1 tests pass.

NOTE: This creates the new `plugins/dso/scripts/lib/` subdirectory, establishing `scripts/lib/` as the pattern for sourced function libraries (distinct from standalone scripts in `scripts/`).

## Implementation requirements

- Library-mode guard: `if [[ "${CI_FINDINGS_LIB_MODE:-0}" == "1" ]]; then return 0; fi`
- Function `_normalize_tier1 <input_path> <output_path>`:
  - Reads reviewer-findings.json from input_path
  - Emits: `{"schema_version": 1, "tier": "llm-review", "findings": [{"severity": "...", "description": "...", "file": "..."}]}`
  - Returns non-zero when input lacks `findings` key
- Must be executable: `chmod +x`

## .test-index
RED marker removal is GATED on test passage:
1. First run `bash tests/scripts/test-ci-findings-normalize.sh` and confirm all 5 PASS
2. Only then: remove the RED marker line from .test-index
3. Add coverage mapping: `plugins/dso/scripts/lib/ci-findings-normalize.sh` → `tests/scripts/test-ci-findings-normalize.sh`

## Files to modify
- plugins/dso/scripts/lib/ci-findings-normalize.sh (CREATE — new file in new lib/ subdirectory)
- .test-index (remove RED marker, add coverage mapping)

## Verify
`bash tests/scripts/test-ci-findings-normalize.sh 2>&1 | grep -c "^PASS"` outputs `5`

Verify lib mode guard: `CI_FINDINGS_LIB_MODE=1 bash -c 'source plugins/dso/scripts/lib/ci-findings-normalize.sh; declare -f _normalize_tier1 | grep -q _normalize_tier1 && echo DEFINED'` outputs `DEFINED` with no other stdout

Verify missing key: `_tmpf=$(mktemp /tmp/no-findings.XXXXXX); _tmpout=$(mktemp /tmp/out.XXXXXX); printf '{"other":1}' > "$_tmpf"; source plugins/dso/scripts/lib/ci-findings-normalize.sh; _normalize_tier1 "$_tmpf" "$_tmpout"; echo $?` outputs non-zero
